script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Pursuit of Glory

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - DAY

A crisp autumn breeze weaves through the halls of BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL, where STUDENTS chat and laugh. Our PROTAGONIST, JENNY, 17, a determined athlete, walks through the corridors, her eyes set on the goalposts outside.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

Jenny enters the gym, where COACH DAVIS, 45, a no-nonsense but caring man, is instructing a group of STUDENTS on the finer points of basketball. Jenny catches his eye and joins the group.

COACH DAVIS
(raising an eyebrow)
Jenny, nice to see you. Ready to help us secure that state title?

JENNY
(smiling)
Absolutely, Coach.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - CAFETERIA - DAY

The team gathers around a table, their faces filled with excitement and anxiety. They discuss strategy and make last-minute adjustments to their game plan. Jenny listens intently, her eyes gleaming with determination.

JENNY
(excited)
We've got this, guys. Let's show those big-city schools what small-town spirit is all about.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - NIGHT

The team practices late into the evening, their energy undiminished. Jenny, exhausted but focused, pushes herself harder than ever before.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - LIBRARY - DAY

Jenny spends hours poring over basketball strategy books, seeking new insights to give her team the edge they need.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The team holds a scrimmage against another local high school. Despite some early setbacks, they pull together, their determination shining through. Jenny leads the charge, her drive and focus inspiring her teammates.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - CLASSROOM - DAY

Jenny balances her schoolwork with her basketball commitments, her teachers recognizing her dedication and hard work. She studies tirelessly, determined to excel both on and off the court.

INT. BULLFROG HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - NIGHT

The team holds a final practice before the big game. They review their strategies, focus on their weaknesses, and encourage one another. Jenny's determination and leadership shine through, and her teammates look to her for inspiration.

INT. COMPETITIVE HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The day of the state championship game arrives. Jenny and her teammates make the long journey to the opposing school, their determination unwavering. They face a formidable opponent, but they refuse to be intimidated.

INT. COMPETITIVE HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The game begins, and the tension is palpable. Both teams battle fiercely, but it's clear that determination and spirit will carry the day. Jenny leads the charge, her teammates following her every move.

INT. COMPETITIVE HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The final buzzer sounds, and the teams exchange exhausted but respectful glances. Jenny's team has emerged victorious, their small-town spirit and unwavering determination carrying them to victory.

INT. COMPETITIVE HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The trophy is presented to Jenny and her teammates, their small-town pride swelling with each word of congratulations. They have proven that spirit and determination can overcome even the biggest obstacles.

FADE OUT.
